title: Shinonome Akito — I Won't Miss It Next Time〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Card: I Won't Miss It Next Time（2★）

rows.Line: Live House
Backstage

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Today's battle ended up being pretty close.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah...
Argh! My throat's totally at its limit!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
And my drink's empty...!
I'm gonna go buy another one. Who wants to come with..?

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: I'll pass...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Urgh... C-Can't move...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Haha. Looks like we've all had it...
In that case, Kohane, let's go grab some drinks for everyone.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay!
se_walk_women_002_1
se_walk_women_002_2

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Still, Okazaki, I couldn't believe how well you guys did. It's like you didn't miss any time at all...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Did you guys keep practicing after that battle?

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Yeah, but we only did warm-ups and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: This might sound pathetic, but we weren't able to go cold turkey.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Which means that fire inside you never went out.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: No, it didn't... But we couldn't work up the nerve to face all of you. We were too afraid of holding you back since we turned tail and ran.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Yeah, I get what you mean...
Man, I wish I knew you guys felt the same way.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Seriously, you guys...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You were all welcome to come back whenever you liked. There's no need to feel so guilty.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If you guys had just told us that you were serious about coming back, we would've believed that you were ready to recommit.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We know how passionate you guys are about what you do, and that you're as tough as nails.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, we wouldn't have asked you guys to join us in the first place if you weren't.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Shinonome...

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line:
Thanks for saying that...
We should've told you this sooner...

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: We're sorry for running away and disappearing after losing to Taiga...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's our fault for not being able to keep you all from running.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That time, we couldn't confidently say, “We're going to surpass Taiga and RAD WEEKEND!” We knew we couldn't at the level we were at... So we just stood there silently.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, we're just as responsible.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Shinonome...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But me, Toya, An, Kohane... We've all improved a lot since we started training with Ken.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So we're never letting anything like that happen again.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We're not letting anyone think for a second that we're not going to surpass RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Akito...

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: You really are such a straightforward and dependable guy.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Oh, also... Please let me buy you all dinner tonight!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
What? Are you sure...?
There's quite a lot of us...

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Not a problem. Also, what's a student saying no to a free meal for?

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Obviously, this doesn't make up for anything. It's really just a way to make me feel better about what we did.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: I'm sorry, and I hope you'll accept.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Alright, if you insist, then why not?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: He says he's paying! What do you guys wanna get?! Oh, how about a buffet?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You sound so eager, Mita...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Come to think of it, there's a place with a dessert buffet near—

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Oh, no sweets.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Why not?! What happened to your offer?!

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line:
I don't like sweets.
How about you, Aoyagi? I'm guessing you could go for a steak or barbeque right now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I'd much rather prefer that.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: See?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (This still isn't everything...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But we've at least managed to recover some of what we lost.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Which does make me happy.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (And I guess...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I guess I like it when we're all hanging out like this.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hm? Did you say something just now, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, nothing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Despite what I just said a second ago, I know it takes a lot of guts to stand back up after being knocked down like that...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Mita, Okazaki and the others are serious. Which is why...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I know we'll be able to put on even better events now we have them back!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Just watch. Things aren't like they were before. Not like when we hit rock bottom.)
